verdict.rationale: An in-dashboard AI insights feature is a fair question for a job and observability platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no first-party feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from a user's run data inside the product. The available items are adjacent only: TRQL Query is manual SQL, the MCP server gives external AI assistants access, and chat.agent and prompts are developer building blocks for constructing one's own AI apps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
